svg.title: Fast draft or final render? fal model options in Microsoft Foundry
svg.desc: Source-based comparison, not generated samples or a benchmark. LTX-2.5 Fast supports rapid iteration, while Pro focuses on output quality; both support synchronized audio. MiniMax H3 Max Turbo and Max support text and image inputs; Max also supports image, video and audio references. Kling v3 Pro supports native audio and multi-shot prompts. Check preview access, region and offering, quota, cost and terms before generation. Live: one real single-take clip generated per model in East US 2 (different prompts; not a benchmark).

g.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: Choose for the decision: explore a concept, then evaluate final quality.
Preview checks: access / region + offering / quota / cost / terms
Live: one real clip per model, East US 2, single takes
